dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (HGBL-DH, 'double-hit' lymphoma), not DLBCL NOS.

dx_gcb_hans.quote: germinal-center phenotype (CD20+, PAX5+, CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1-

tx_plan_outdated.quote: I am cancelling the planned R-CHOP and starting curative-intent DA-EPOCH-R

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIA, bulky: right cervical levels II-IV nodal disease plus a 12.0 cm anterior mediastinal mass, all above the diaphragm

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: with high MYC and BCL2 protein expression and very high proliferation (Ki-67 95%)
bio_double_expressor_secondary.note: Notes high MYC/BCL2 protein but never names double-expressor status or contrasts it with FISH.

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: IPI 1 (low), age-adjusted IPI 1 (low-intermediate), and CNS-IPI 1 (low). However, the double-hit histology dominates prognosis

tx_intensive_curative.quote: starting curative-intent DA-EPOCH-R (dose-adjusted etoposide, prednisone, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, plus rituximab) for 6 cycles

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will perform a lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry before cycle 1.
cns_staging_mri_csf.note: LP/CSF ordered and DH treated as high risk, but no baseline brain MRI recommended.

cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will give CNS prophylaxis with intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg for 4 doses starting with cycle 2

resp_pet_lugano.quote: again 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 using Lugano/Deauville criteria

sup_gcsf.quote: DA-EPOCH-R requires pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 6, or filgrastim, with nadir-based dose adjustment.

sup_tls.quote: Start allopurinol 300 mg daily and aggressive hydration now, check G6PD, and give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg before cycle 1 if G6PD is normal

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: the 96-hour infusion and frequent visits of DA-EPOCH-R are feasible with his support and proximity
sup_central_access_infusion.note: Mentions 96-hour infusion and port placement separately but never links infusion to central access.

sup_svc_airway.quote: Monitor for SVC syndrome and airway compromise, with head-of-bed elevation and urgent evaluation for stridor or worsening facial swelling

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive (immune), so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54, ECOG 1, working, LVEF 60%
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF cited as part of fitness rather than explicitly as anthracycline clearance.

fit_intensive.quote: He is fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54, ECOG 1, working, LVEF 60%, normal renal and hepatic function
